Objective:
 1  This course is designed to impart fundamental knowledge on the clinical development
     process of drugs, pharmaceuticals, and Medical Devices, phases and conduct of clinical
      trials and research, regulations, and guidance governing the conduct of clinical research in
     India, the USA, and the EU. It prepares the students to learn in detail about various laws,
     legislations, and guidance related to safety, efficacy, ethical conduct, and regulatory
     approval of clinical research.

 2  Clinical drug, medical device development process, and different types and phases of
     clinical trials.
